summary: MOGU Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 22, 2026, reporting unaudited financial results for the six months ended March 31, 2026 and fiscal year 2026. The filing details a 28.5% year-over-year revenue decline to RMB56.7 million and narrowed operating loss. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer, with no mention of any shareholder vote, deal terms, or strategic alternatives. There is no event that constitutes a special situation.
